maria: Quick help — I have a request_id `abc123ef` from a customer report. Need the raw log lines and trace. What's the fastest path in Console and from a machine with only SSH (no web UI)?

kai: Console: Observability -> Logs, then search `request_id:abc123ef` or `http.request_id:abc123ef`. If you only have a trace id use `trace_id:...`. Also open the Request Inspector from the request list and click `Open trace`.

alex: CLI (on your laptop): we have a helper. Example:
```
# stream logs for a request id (requires rw/auth)
redwood logs find --request-id abc123ef --since 10m --format raw
```
It returns host + pod + lines. If you don't have the `redwood` CLI, use kube logs on the pod returned.

maria: I only have SSH into a bastion and `curl`, no rw cli. Any quick curl endpoints?

kai: You can hit the internal lookup API (requires token):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://observability.internal.redwood/v1/requests/lookup?request_id=abc123ef" | jq
```
It returns trace_id and node/pod metadata. Then use `kubectl logs` for the pod if you can access k8s.

alex: If the lookup is sampled out (no trace_id), try prefix-search for the request id in logs index: `logs query '"abc123ef"'` — sometimes the header is logged as `x-request-id` or `req-id`.

sre-bot: Found a trace for abc123ef: https://tracing.redwood.ai/trace/4d2f... (span count: 12) — use `redwood tracing open 4d2f...` to jump directly from CLI.

maria: perfect — saw the trace link. One follow-up: how to handle when request_id is not unique across services?

kai: Use trace_id as canonical. If you only have request_id, include the timestamp window and service name in the search: `service:payments AND "abc123ef" AND @timestamp>=2026-03-15T12:00:00`.

alex: Tip: for future debugging we log `request_id` + `trace_id` at ingress. Add a small middleware if you see gaps. Also check sampling rate in APM config — low sampling can drop traces.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup: saved the trace and fetched logs. I'll open a quick PR to add more request_id logs to payments service.

kai: nice. If you run into missing logs ping `#eng-oncall` and include the trace link and `kubectl get pods -n payments` output.

sre-bot: Reminder: logs retention for free tier is 7d; file a request to `eng-infra` for extended retention if needed.
